WITH source AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id, to_date(ctl_validfrom) ORDER BY ctl_validfrom DESC) AS rn
  FROM ${snp_src_schema_name}.com_sbt_bm_ucp_retail_model_individual_birthplace src
  WHERE ctl_action != 'D'
)
SELECT
  -- keys
  1 AS priority,
  cast(split(split(key, '\\.')[0], '_')[1] AS BIGINT) AS epk_id,
  -- business fields
  source.value                                        AS bp_value,
  CASE WHEN enddate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END         AS active_flag,
  -- dates
  updatedatetime,
  startdate,
  enddate,
  versionstartdate,
  coalesce(to_date(startdate), to_date(ctl_validfrom))              AS startdate_date,
  coalesce(to_date(versionstartdate), to_date(ctl_validfrom))       AS versionstartdate_date,
  -- tech
  ctl_loading, ctl_validfrom, cast('9999-12' AS STRING) AS month
FROM source
WHERE rn = 1
